cleared_note: 2026-09-23: emptied. Every figure the census found is now live, declared, quoted, a registered computed artefact, or a retired value quoted as history; or it stopped rendering. Live counts became data-fig spans over populations in tools/populations.py; the calendar stratum and the people-served runs became computed artefacts (tools/calendar_stratum.py, tools/wpop_pipeline_figures.py, tools/render_ttr_table.py); nearest-point distances render from data/nearest_point_distances.json; VPA-DD values are in PARAMS; the Improved Cooking precedent is a quotation; 628, 606, 617 and 727 are marked retired. Stopped rendering: 722, 237 and 485 (they rest on the withdrawn per-year carbon basis), 353.0 and 353.4 (the 44-pump list cannot be rebuilt), 741 (a form count stored nowhere), 732 (the sentence stands without it), and USD 29, USD 20 and USD 21,200 (carbon money at a price declared nowhere).
correction_note: 2026-09-23: thirteen figures were classified W (withdraw) by a crude first pass that matched on value alone. They are not carbon money - four are census false positives (a form _rev, a question count, an identifier fragment), two are quoted from the Gold Standard monitoring report, six are derivable counts, and 20,827 is a live product of a population and two quoted per-point values. Withdrawing them would have deleted true facts. Corrected before anything was removed.
deferred_note: The people-served figures are deferred, not unexplained. See the per-figure why: capturing them is a change to what sdws1_population.py EMITS, not to the model, and was judged not worth half a day for 14 prose figures on 2026-09-23.
disposition_note: D derive from a population or a captured artefact; P declare as a chosen parameter or an external quotation, which is a source class not a computation; W withdraw the sentence. Counted 2026-09-22 before any of it was applied.
